exposure: Early postpartum discharge during COVID-19 pandemic vs routine postpartum discharge
early postpartum discharge during the COVID-19 pandemic
finding: Early postpartum discharge during the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with no change in the odds of maternal postpartum readmissions after low-risk vaginal or cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Early postpartum discharge was not associated with an increase in odds of hospital readmissions after vaginal or cesarean delivery.
